req.title: Chain N redirects
req.statement: The system shall redirect the client N times when GET /redirect/<n> is called, ending at /get on the final hop.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET /redirect/<n> must produce N-1 intermediate 302 responses and a final 200 at /get. I design tests covering: (1) a typical positive case with n=3 to verify the chain length and final destination; (2) boundary n=1 (minimum valid value, single hop directly to /get with 302); (3) boundary n=2 (one intermediate 302 then final /get); (4) a negative case with n=0 which should trigger the assert n>0 guard (500 or 4xx); (5) a state-transition test verifying each hop in the chain produces exactly 302 until the final 200; (6) a decision-table test verifying the Location header at each step points to the correct next URL. All tests use Flask test_client with follow_redirects=False to inspect individual hops, ensuring mutation-resilient exact-value assertions.

tests.name: test_redirect_n3_positive_chain
expected: First response: 302 with Location pointing to /redirect/2
Second response: 302 with Location pointing to /redirect/1
Third response: 302 with Location pointing to /get
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n3_positive_chain():
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/3', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    loc1 = r1.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/2' in loc1

    r2 = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    loc2 = r2.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/1' in loc2

    r3 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r3.status_code == 302
    loc3 = r3.headers['Location']
    assert '/get' in loc3

    r4 = client.get('/get', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r4.status_code == 200

test_redirect_n3_positive_chain()

tests.name: test_redirect_state_transition_n4
preconditions: n=4 exercises full state transition chain
actions: GET /redirect/4 and follow each hop manually
Record status code at each state transition
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_state_transition_n4():
    paths = ['/redirect/4', '/redirect/3', '/redirect/2', '/redirect/1']
    for path in paths:
        r = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302 at {path}, got {r.status_code}'
    r_final = client.get('/get', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r_final.status_code == 200
    import json
    data = json.loads(r_final.data)
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'headers' in data

test_redirect_state_transition_n4()

tests.name: test_redirect_location_header_exact_n3
preconditions: Location header must decrement n at each hop
actions: GET /redirect/3 and check Location header value
GET /redirect/2 and check Location header value
GET /redirect/1 and check Location header value ends at /get
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_location_header_exact_n3():
    r3 = client.get('/redirect/3', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r3.status_code == 302
    assert '/redirect/2' in r3.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/3' not in r3.headers['Location']

    r2 = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    assert '/redirect/1' in r2.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect/2' not in r2.headers['Location']

    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    assert '/get' in r1.headers['Location']
    assert '/redirect' not in r1.headers['Location']

test_redirect_location_header_exact_n3()

tests.name: test_redirect_follow_all_n3_final_200
actions: Assert response body contains url and headers keys from /get
expected: Response JSON contains 'url' and 'headers' keys (from view_get)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_follow_all_n3_final_200():
    r = client.get('/redirect/3', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'origin' in data

test_redirect_follow_all_n3_final_200()
